ws_5a94800327.853b0af619d6: A.C. armature windings can be either concentrated or distributed, with each type having its own advantages and disadvantages. Distributed windings are generally used in a.c. armature windings and have two principal advantages: they generate a voltage wave that is nearly a sine curve, and copper is evenly distributed on the armature surface.

ws_ccd282f888.91bb66d26f31: Explains the benefits of symmetrically distributed windings for uniform voltage waveforms and heating, and distinguishes full‑pitch coils (180° electrical span) from fractional‑pitch coils (less than 180°) and their impact on induced EMF.
